title: Deefy
description:
Building a one-stop solution for anyone interested in blockchain technology to track a wallet address, monitor blockchains' data, get the whale's transactions, or look at the pool analytics. You don't have to visit hundreds of DApps to make better financial decisions in the web3 space. Deefy provides all the facilities, from tracking your last transactions to monitoring the analytics of the pool to make better decisions.

Suppose you are a new user transitioning from Web2 to Web3. In that case, you will need to switch numerous blockchains, block scanners, and DApps to perform anything on-chain, such as portfolio management, transaction tracking, or remaining up to date with the hottest crypto news. And because this could limit Web3's true potential, Deefy assists you by providing a one-stop multichain platform for your daily Deefy needs.
how_its_made:
-> Firstly, I must find a reliable blockchain data API to power Deefy's Infrastructure.
-> Secondly, I ran into the problem of tracking various pools available on chains.
-> Thirdly, I ran into an issue with monitoring the ETH staked by multiple users.

I have solved these issues by integrating Covalent and Dune Analytics into Deefy,
